behaviors.name: Tumble
behaviors.intent: Tumble and drift left; wrap around.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  rotate self by (self.spin * dt, self.spin * 0.6 * dt, 0)
  move self by (0 - self.drift * dt, 0, 0)
  if self.position.x < -34 then
    self.position.x = 34
  end
end

behaviors.name: Pilot
behaviors.intent: Weave up and down, firing a steady laser stream.
behaviors.source:
behavior Pilot
  on tick
    self.position = (-9 + sin(time * 0.4) * 2, sin(time * 0.75) * 4.5, 0)
    self.rotation = (cos(time * 0.75) * -18, 0, cos(time * 0.75) * 8)
    every 0.13 seconds
      spawn("prefab:prefabs/laser.prefab.json", self.position + (1.9, 0, 0))
    end
  end
  on event "kill"
    self.score = self.score + 1
  end
end

behaviors.name: Waves
behaviors.intent: Raiders arrive in short waves from the right.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  every 0.55 seconds
    let y = random(-7, 7)
    let r = spawn("prefab:prefabs/raider.prefab.json", (30, y, 0))
    r.phase = random(0, 6.28)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Drift
behaviors.intent: Hold the battle in frame with a gentle drift.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.position = (1 + sin(time * 0.2) * 1.5, 1.5 + sin(time * 0.15) * 1, 23)
  look self at (2, 0, -6)
end
